Warnings array is empty even for malformed HTML (parser is lenient)

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Unclosed paragraph<div>Mixed nesting</p></div>", ConversionOptions())
    println(result.content)
    println(result.warnings)
}
```
